page.overview:
Who is Fume?

Fume grew up in Suki's village on Kyoshi Island during the late Hundred Year War. She experienced Team Avatar's visit and Zuko's raid on Kyoshi Island in 99 AG, helping to rebuild her home village afterward. When the leader of her Kyoshi Warrior team, Suki, asked her comrades whether they were willing to venture to the Earth Kingdom mainland to help others just as Avatar Aang did, Fume volunteered alongside Aika, Mira, and Rie.

After leaving their home per ship, one of the team's first destinations was Razor Reef in the southern Mo Ce Sea. There, the group sought a local martial arts master named Tidao, only to discover that the latter had long left the location. Yet they used the opportunity for a friendly sparring session with some local adventurers who were guarding an archaeologist, Wen, at Razor Reef. They then continued their journey to the mainland.

Once on the mainland, the group sought contacts to the Earth Kingdom Army. A fisherman claimed that they could find the military at Pebble Pond Village, offering to sell them ostrich horses as mounts for the journey. When Rie mentioned that they were Kyoshi Warriors, however, the fisherman was horrified due to hearing tales of the warriors' brutality, and gifted them the ostrich horses before running away. Like most of her comrades, Fume was left confused by the incident.

Suki's group subsequently journeyed to Pebble Pond Village. As they traveled on their ostrich horses, Fume used her free time to study the local flora and fauna. When Rie later expressed disquiet about the fisherman's fearful reception reaction and its wider implications, Fume tried to ease her worries by pointing out that the mainlanders were just not used to Kyoshi Warriors.
